product_family: Superalloy bar, billet and remelt stock
note: 2025 and 2035 at constant 2024 unit values (real). Tonnes are team estimates (model_family_tonnes.csv). Unit values are EU27 extra EU import and export values (AC_EU_NI_UNITVAL_2024) and include pure nickel grades, so the range is indicative. Central range = P50 tonnes x low to high unit value, band = P10 tonnes x low to P90 tonnes x high. Families overlap and are never summed. Superalloy premium over the bar unit value (MODEL_VALUE_SUPER_PREMIUM) is a team assumption. Remelt stock and ingot sell below bar, so the value is an upper indication.
label: team estimate, not summable
